tex_content.html:
There is an open neighborhood $V$ of $(M-\Omega )\times \{ T\} $ in $M\times [0,T]$ on which $R^{-1}$ extends continuously and vanishes on $(M-\Omega )\times \{ T\} $.
Proof

↗ lem:kl-structure-at-first-singularity-time-structure-at-first-singularity-time-lemma \sketch The characterization of $M-\Omega $ by the limit of $R^{-1}$ and the spacetime derivative estimates (4) give the continuous extension along suitable spacetime paths.

□
